story.text: # 0xagentprivacy — The Guide

Welcome to the **federated guide** to agentprivacy: the dual-agent privacy framework, the skills its agents carry, the canon that grounds it, and the city it lives in. Everything here is a **forkable wiki page** — read it, fork it, write on it, carry it away with its lineage. The git repositories remain the source of truth; this wiki is a projection that records its origin.

## The federation

The guide is the front door. Each part of the canon is its own forkable wiki site:

- 🗃️ **The Skill Library** (LIVE) — 163 forkable skills — 42 personas + role / privacy-layer / meta / wikis. Fork any page to materialize a local `SKILL.md`.
- 📖 **The Tomes & Cast** (LIVE) — the Second-Person Spellbook (59 acts, Tomes I–X — incl. IX the Horizon and X the Hearth) + cast + 12 specs — the lore that holds the system.
- 🧮 **The Research & Conjectures** (LIVE) — the privacy-value model V(π,t), the conjecture register C1–C96 (one page each, incl. Band X — the Hearthold Reading), and the PVM v6 papers.
- 🌐 **The Atlas** (LIVE) — the knowledge graph — 683 nodes and 1,654 edges — the backbone that hyperlinks every other site.
- 📚 **The Library** (LIVE) — the five narrative spellbooks — the Story, Parallel Society, Plurality, the Privacymage Grimoire (Zero), and the blockchain Canon — full book prose, one page per act/chapter/tale.
- ⿻ **The Harness** (LIVE) — the dual-agent harness — soulbae 🧙 proposes, soulbis ⚔️ proves, the Gap ⿻ holds them apart: seven seats, six trusts, ten ground rules, and fifteen workshop paths grouped by loop weight — built for trust-graph construction: a validated result proposes an edge, only a signature mints it.
- 🔮 **The Grimoire** (LIVE) — the grimoire as a spellbook of atoms — 70 spells, 18 incantations, 17 vertices, proverbs, blades, principles, and Selene’s Spellbook poems, each forkable and cross-linked to its persona.
- ⚖️ **The Grammar Workshop** (LIVE) — the Lexon x Privacy Value Model workshop — the privacy model's canon written in controlled legal-English, 189 of 211 terms with machine-checkable structural claims (coverage 211 → 22), run through the dual-agent harness.
- 🕸️ **The Trust Graph Lab** (LIVE) — the DTG ZKP research corpus — the Predicate & Assurance-Boundary decision baseline (split per §), nineteen explorations, and the lab evidence layer (16 suites · 162 properties, real circuits included) — projected from the research root, rebuilt by one command.
- 📜 **The Agreement Layer** (LIVE) — MyTerms / IEEE Std 7012™-2025 — the agreement layer: the founding-member application to the MyTerms Alliance (Customer Commons), the integration plan into the dual-agent architecture, and the two browser familiars. The standard specifies agreement, not enforcement.
- ⛩️ **Kyra Gate** (LIVE) — KYRA — Know Your Runtime Agent: the checkpoint where an AI agent earns, and loses, the right to act. Understanding as key, the witness draw, det(Σ) sovereignty volume, bilateral credentials, a tamper-evident audit rail. Vera flies; Mirage is sandboxed.
- 🌀 **The Improbable Engine** (LIVE) — the lattice lab improbable engine — the 64-vertex sovereignty lattice closed into a torus, six strands (five Lattice Labs + the FedWiki hearth), a live farm seated on the geometry. Fork it and run your own grid.
- 🧭 **The Field Guide** (LIVE) — the Hitchhikers Field Guide trust overlay — a walking AR client meets the DTG trust-graph work: the Meet rite, eight suites and 124 properties, nine proverbs, and the rulings (audience is granted not computed · a wiki fork is not an audience · shared quest is not consent). Built on the field farm, served from the embassy Pis, merged home 2026-08-17.
